cards.title: Offset Pagination
cards.description: Simple, but deep pages get slower and changing data can shift results.

cards.title: Cursor Pagination
cards.code:
SELECT * FROM posts
WHERE (created_at, id) < ($cursorTime, $cursorId)
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 21;
cards.description: Use a unique tie-breaker for stable ordering.

cards.title: Limit + 1
cards.description: Avoid a separate count query when total count is unnecessary.

cards.title: Encode Cursor
cards.code:
cursor = base64url(JSON.stringify({ createdAt, id }))
// Decode, validate schema, then bind as query parameters.
cards.description: Signing prevents clients from tampering with internal cursor data.

cards.title: Bidirectional
cards.code:
after + first => forward
before + last => backward
reverse query order, then reverse results
cards.description: Clearly define edge behavior and ordering.

cards.title: Index Match
cards.code: CREATE INDEX posts_page_idx ON posts (created_at DESC, id DESC);
cards.description: The index should match filters and ordering.
